svg.title: Wireframe 1: group board on a phone, live state
svg.desc: Greyscale wireframe of the LiftOff Comp group board at 375 px width during the Snatch. Top: next-lifter panel with name, weight, plate diagram, three judge flag toggles and an Enter result button. Below: the lifter table sorted by next weight, a tracked row with a T-minus estimate, finished lifters at the bottom and the Clean and Jerk list underneath.
svg.text: Wireframe 1 · Group board · phone (375 px) · live state
Snatch in progress, results already entered. Greyscale layout only: colours, fonts and icons are placeholders until the visual tokens (stage 3). Names and numbers are made up.

g.text: 29 kg per side on a 15 kg bar

svg.text: screen bottom
Notes
Auto-refresh
Refreshes itself about every 15 s. Tap ↻ to refresh right now.
No connection: “Offline · showing data from 13:52”, never an error page.
The text is not a live region, so screen readers are not interrupted.
Phase
SNATCH → CLEAN & JERK → DONE. Worked out from the attempts, never set by hand.
Next-lifter panel
Always the first attempt in the lifting order. If a weight is edited and another
lifter becomes first, the panel switches by itself and toggled flags reset.
Name, club, lot, bodyweight, attempt number and weight at a glance.
Plate diagram
Uses the lifter's own bar: 15 kg for women, 20 kg for men. Schematic here;
ported from the Weightlifting Calculator (metal plates, no 1.25 kg).
Judge flags
Left, centre, right judge in a fixed order. All white by default; tap toggles
white ⇄ red. Outline = white, filled with ✗ = red, so colour is not the only cue.
The preview line shows the result before it is sent (2+ white = good lift).
Enter result
Sends the three flags and the weight that is shown. The weight cell turns green
or red and the panel moves to the next lifter. Refused if the weight changed
meanwhile or a result already exists (another coach was faster).
Lifter table
A real <table>. Lowest next weight first; tie: lower attempt number, then lot.
Tap a lifter's name to open options under the row: stop this lift, withdraw, track.
Weight cells
Tap a weight to edit it: blank input, click away to save, blank restores the old value.
A weight that breaks the rules keeps its old value and shows a message (next wireframe).
Tracked lifter (ME)
T–4 = four lifts before my turn. After the first result: minutes and clock time too.
A coach can track two lifters; each gets its own strip. When the list is long
and scrolled, a sticky bar under the top bar keeps the T-minus in view (wireframe 2, J).
Finished and stopped
Lifters with no attempts left sit at the bottom. Stopped lifters show Restore
right in the row, so a mis-click is easy to undo.
Clean & Jerk
Lives under the Snatch list and moves to the top when the Snatch is done.
Weight cell states
Good lift
No-lift
Not lifted yet
Next attempt (in panel)
Estimate, not confirmed
Cancelled (stopped)
To decide
Flags and Enter result sit in the panel at
the top (as in your brief). On a phone the
thumb reaches the bottom more easily.
Option B: a sticky result bar at the bottom.
